clusters.title: UnitDies(Who) trigger subject
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: add Trigger::UnitDies(Who) (Who::Friendly, and Who::Enemy as the EnemyUnitDies alias) and a `buffed: bool` on Noted (engine/ctx.rs Event::Died.noted, filled by kill.rs before the card state is dropped). engine/triggers.rs matches: on Event::Died { card, controller, unit: true, .. } hand every in-play source of the same controller (Friendly) or the other seat (Enemy) the dead unit as the subject/argument, excluding the source itself for Friendly (that stays Trigger::Death). Conditions (viktor_leader, shard_of_undoing, vanguard_helm) read the subject and Noted.buffed. Once::PerTurn already works for wraith_of_echoes. Rules 359.3, 465.

clusters.title: Equipment abilities on the wearer (Grant::Ability)
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: add Grant::Ability(&'static [Ability]) usable inside Static::WhileAttached. engine/triggers.rs sources/find_among/matches: for every unit, also walk the Grant::Ability lists of its attached gear (attach.rs granted_statics) and of any copied_text (svellsongur, 136.2.c), resolving each as the WEARER's own ability: Source { card: wearer, ability: index offset into a granted range }, Who::Me = the wearer, the wearer's controller as the trigger's controller. Ability lookup by Source (triggers::ability_of / activate::ability_at) must resolve the offset range back to the gear's script so the run and candidates are found. skyfall_of_areion needs matches to consult matches_through_the_skyfall (a Conquer match also fires the wearer's Hold abilities and vice versa) — model it as a Grant on WhileAttached that triggers::matches consults when the wearer's own triggers are matched. sacred_shears also needs Trigger::UnitDies(Who::Friendly) granted through this path (depends on unit-dies-friendly). eye_of_the_herald's Recruit and trapping-style token faces keep their hand-built faces here.

clusters.title: Activated abilities lent by another card (Grant::Ability with UnitsHere/legend scope)
clusters.primitive: engine/activate.rs ability_at and offers: beside the source's own script, list Grant::Ability entries projected onto the unit by Static::Aura { scope: UnitsHere } (gardens_of_becoming::lent_ability), onto the holder's legend by a new Scope::Legend on Static::Aura (forge_of_the_fluft::lent_ability), and Heimerdinger - Inventor's borrowed abilities: an activation whose source is the borrowing card and whose ability index points into another card's script (activate::activate takes a (source, script_card, index) triple; pay_self exhausts the borrower, not the owner). Offers disappear when the unit leaves the scope. Uses the Grant::Ability arm and Source-offset resolution from wearer-abilities.

clusters.title: Excess combat damage recorded per attack
clusters.primitive: engine/combat.rs: when lethal is assigned, record excess = assigned - remaining Might per defender and sum it per attack into a blob row (SeatState or a per-zone record) keyed by attacking seat and zone, kept for the turn (cleared at Expiration), not healed away by cleanup::after_combat. Expose Ctx::excess_damage_in_attack(seat, zone) -> Option<u8>; tryndamere_barbarian::excess_damage_assigned_in_my_attack reads it. Conditions on Conquer/CombatWon triggers (Sivir, Tryndamere, Vi, Yeti, Trapping Grounds) read it when queued. hextech_gauntlets:350 also needs the wearer's conquer trigger from wearer-abilities. Rules 712-715.

clusters.title: Who::Enemy / Who::Any on Move, Attacks, ChosenFriendly, Readied
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: add Who::Enemy and Who::Any. engine/ctx.rs Event::Moved gains `by: Option<u8>` (the seat whose spell/ability moved the unit; None for a standard move) set by march::effect_move and Ctx::move_unit callers. engine/triggers.rs matches: Trigger::Move { of: Enemy|Any } admits movers of the other seat / any seat and hands the mover as the subject; Trigger::Attacks(Who::Enemy) hands an enemy attacker to a legend's or battlefield's condition (ahri_nine_tailed_fox::an_enemy_unit_attacks_a_battlefield_you_control); Trigger::ChosenFriendly with Who::Any lets the opponent choosing their own unit count (the_dreaming_tree); Trigger::Readied(Who::Friendly) hands the readied unit over as the subject instead of matching only the source (pirates_haven). Volibear and Blast Cone read Event::Moved.by for 'an opponent's effect'.

clusters.title: Trigger::CombatEnded(Who) with a per-turn damage record
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Trigger::CombatEnded(Who). engine/cleanup.rs after_combat: raise Event::CombatEnded { zone, units: Vec<u32>, result } listing every unit that was in the combat, won, lost or drawn, BEFORE healing; triggers::matches queues it for each listed unit with Who::Me = that unit. CardState gains damage_taken_this_turn (u8, written by Ctx::damage, reset at Expiration) so affectionate_poro's condition can read damage after after_combat healed the board (the Poro draws only if it took none).

clusters.title: Trigger::ShowdownBegins(Where::Here)
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Trigger::ShowdownBegins(Where). engine/showdown.rs open (combat and non-combat showdowns, 464.2.b): raise Event::ShowdownBegins { zone, attacker: u8, defender: u8 } as the showdown opens; triggers::matches queues battlefield cards at that zone (Where::Here) and units standing there (Diana - Lunari's controller pays the energy). threshold_of_the_gray's run banks one energy per side through the existing next_discount; the per-seat pool is the economy lane's banked-rune-pool and not needed for this test.

clusters.title: Trigger::Attached(Who::Me) and per-turn mode memory
clusters.primitive: engine/attach.rs attach: raise Event::Attached { gear, to, by }. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Attached(Who) matched with the wearer as Who::Me (Jax pays one energy to draw). For Aphelios, CardState gains modes_used_this_turn: u8 bitmask (reset at Expiration) written by the script through Ctx::mark_mode(card, index) and read by modes_left; the Resume candidates already carry labels, so the offer drops modes already marked this turn.

clusters.title: Event::Stunned and Trigger::Stunned / YouStunEnemy
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::stun: raise Event::Stunned { units: Vec<u32>, by: u8 (controller of the stunning item) } once per stun instruction (a batch of units is one event). Noted gains `stunned: bool` filled by kill.rs before the state is dropped. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Stunned(Who) where Who::You matches by == source controller and the condition filters enemy units (eclipse_herald, vex_mocking read a stunned enemy at a battlefield as the subject; leona_radiant_dawn queues once per batch).

clusters.title: Event::Died carries its killer
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Event::Died gains `killer: Option<Killer>` (Killer { item: u16, controller: u8, kind: Spell|Ability|Combat|Rule }) filled by kill.rs from Cause. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::UnitKilledBy(KilledBy::YourSpell | YourItem | Enemy). solari_shrine's condition reads killer.controller == you and noted.stunned (depends on stunned-event for Noted.stunned).

clusters.title: Event::Buffed / Event::BuffSpent and their triggers
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs: Ctx::buff raises Event::Buffed { card, by: controller of the buffing item }; Ctx::spend_buff raises Event::BuffSpent { card, by }. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Buffed(Who) (Who::Me the source itself, Who::Friendly a friendly unit handed over as the subject) and Trigger::BuffSpent(Who::You). Mistfall offers with_cost + exhausting_self to ready the buffed unit; Simian Ancestor readies himself; Fae Dragon mints an exhausted Gold per spent buff.

clusters.title: Event::BecameMighty raised by every Might writer
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs: every writer that changes current_might (Ctx::might, buff, empower, grants recompute after attach/detach, aura changes) compares current_might before and after and raises Event::BecameMighty { card, threshold } when it crosses 5 upward (709), and Event::MightReached { card, n } for the thresholds a script registers (Renekton at 10). cards/mod.rs: Trigger::BecameMighty(Who) and Trigger::MightReached(Who, u8). Fiora - Worthy: optional(with_cost(triggered(BecameMighty(Friendly)), ORDER)); Fiora - Grand Duelist queues once; Renekton - Brute empowers himself after the sixth activation.

clusters.title: When::MainPhaseOf(seat) and When::HeldBy(seat) delayed triggers
clusters.primitive: state.rs When: add MainPhaseOf(u8) and HeldBy(u8) with CBOR codes. engine/phases.rs continue_beginning: as the Action phase opens (316.4, after the rune pool empties 316.3) call triggers::queue_delayed(When::MainPhaseOf(seat)); engine/cleanup.rs score_holds: after a seat's hold scores call queue_delayed(When::HeldBy(seat)). queue_delayed must not require the source to be on the board (ashe_focused's source may be gone). Ctx::delay(when, source, seat, ability, args) already stores Delayed. Iascylla / Blue Sentinel delay their hold effects to that turn's Main Phase with the held battlefield as args; bottled_constellation's wish is queued as the main phase opens (its kills stay a Resume pick here).

clusters.title: Event::PlayedSpell carries card, origin and paid cost
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Event::PlayedSpell gains `card: u32, origin: Origin, paid: Cost (energy and power actually spent), from_hidden: bool`, filled by chain.rs from the ChainItem BEFORE chain::leave drops the item and card state (raise it at resolution start, or snapshot the item when it finalizes). triggers::matches keeps the same subjects; conditions read origin (Facedown => black_market_broker / ember_monk, Trash => Kennen's Flow spell), paid.energy (forgotten_library, revna, jhin_virtuoso) and paid.power (yordle_explorer).

clusters.title: Event::Discarded and Trigger::Discarded
clusters.primitive: engine/discard.rs (and Ctx::discard): raise Event::Discarded { by: u8 (the discarding seat), cards: Vec<u32>, owner: u8 } once per discard instruction, after the cards reach the trash. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Discarded(Who) — Who::You matches by == source controller and queues once for the batch (jinx_rebel readies through the chain); Who::Me matches a card in the batch (used by triggers-off-the-board).

clusters.title: Triggers sourced from hand, trash and deck top
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Card gains `listens_from: &'static [ListenZone]` (Hand, Trash, DeckTop) or the Ability gains a `from: ListenZone`. engine/triggers.rs sources: beside in-play cards, walk each seat's hand, trash and top-of-deck cards whose script declares the zone and match their abilities with that card as the source (Discarded(Who::Me) heard as the card lands in the trash; Conquer heard from the trash by Super Mega Death Rocket; Trigger::UnitKilledBy(YourSpell) from the trash for Immortal Phoenix). Ctx::peek_top / look effects raise Event::Looked { seat, cards } so Nocturne's DeckTop trigger fires when his controller looks at him. The runs play the source from its zone with the existing limited play (play::begin with Origin::Trash { leave } / Origin::Hand-from-deck) for the printed or stated cost. Depends on discarded-event and died-killer.

clusters.title: Turn-scoped watchers registered by a resolved item
clusters.primitive: state.rs: a blob row Floating { source: u32, seat: u8, ability: u8, args: Vec<u32>, until: Expiry } registered by Ctx::watch_this_turn(source, ability, args) from a resolving script and cleared at Expiration. engine/triggers.rs sources: include floating rows as sources whose script is the source card's (even when the card is in the trash), with args as the subject (Deadly Flourish / Siphoning Strike hear their target's Died later this turn; Noxian Guillotine hears the next Damaged on its target and kills it; Imperial Decree hears Trigger::Damaged(Who::Any) over every unit; Rally the Troops hears Trigger::YouPlayCard for the turn). Builds on the beyond-in-play sources refactor of triggers-off-the-board.

clusters.title: Abilities granted to a unit for the turn
clusters.primitive: CardState gains granted_abilities: Vec<(source: u32, index: u8, until: Expiry)> written by Ctx::grant_ability_this_turn(unit, source, index) and cleared at Expiration. engine/activate.rs ability_at/offers list them as the unit's own (Dominus: '2 any power: Ready me.' offered this turn only); engine/triggers.rs sources/matches fire them as the unit's own triggers (Relentless Pursuit: 'When I conquer, you may move me to my base'; Grim Resolve: 'When it wins a combat this turn, gain 2 XP'). Reuses the Grant::Ability resolution of wearer-abilities and the offset lookup of lent-activated-abilities.

clusters.title: Event::Recycled and Trigger::Recycled(Who)
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs: Ctx::recycle (cards and runes) and pay.rs's rune recycle raise Event::Recycled { by: u8, cards: Vec<u32>, runes: bool } once per recycle instruction. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Recycled(Who::You) with a condition reading runes (sivir_battle_mistress asks to exhaust her for a Gold) or a Vision recycle (karma_channeler — cross-lane: also needs the statics lane's implicit Vision trigger; un-ignore after the merge).

clusters.title: Battlefield BeginningPhase triggers for the turn player
clusters.primitive: engine/triggers.rs matches: a battlefield card's Trigger::BeginningPhase currently matches owner_of(source) == event seat; add Who to the trigger (BeginningPhase(Who::You) keeps the holder, BeginningPhase(Who::Any) matches every seat's Beginning Phase with the turn player as the trigger's controller) so 'each player's Beginning Phase' fires for the second player while the first holds the battlefield (Obelisk, Frozen Fortress, The Arena's Greatest).

clusters.title: Event::Scored and Who::Enemy on Hold/Conquer
clusters.primitive: engine/cleanup.rs score paths (conquer, hold, score effects via Ctx::score): raise Event::Scored { seat, zone: Option<u16>, points, how: Conquer|Hold|Effect }. cards/mod.rs: Trigger::Scored(Who) and Who::Enemy admitted on Hold/Conquer; sumpworks_map draws on an opponent's score.

clusters.title: Events the Ctx writers do not raise yet (bounce, leave alive, hide, conquer holder)
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs: Ctx::bounce raises Event::ReturnedToHand { card, from: Location, owner }; a card leaving the board alive (bounce, banish, recycle of a permanent) raises Event::LeftBoard { card, controller, how } matched by a new Trigger::LeavesBoard (treasure_trove draws and channels when bounced); hide::hide raises Event::Hidden { card, seat, zone } matched by Trigger::YouHide (katarina readies); Event::Conquered gains `was_open: bool` / `previous_holder: Option<u8>` captured before cleanup::establish flips control (yone_blademaster, 170.11.c). Trigger arms hand the owner (ReturnedToHand) as the controller for rippers_bay's pay-one-to-channel.

clusters.title: Statics that queue a trigger match again
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::ExtraTriggers { kind: Hold|Conquer|Deathknell, applies: fn(&Ctx, source, zone_or_card) -> u8 }. engine/triggers.rs collect and deathknells: after queueing a Hold/Conquer match at a zone (Blue Sentinel / Red Brambleback standing there, their controller's triggers) or a Death match (Karthus on the board, his controller's Deathknells), consult in-play statics and push the same item that many additional times.

clusters.title: Temporary consults a veto before killing
clusters.primitive: engine/triggers.rs find_among IMPLICIT_TEMPORARY Beginning-phase arm: before queueing a Temporary kill for a unit, consult in-play cards for a Static::TemporaryVeto(AuraWhen)-style hook (leblanc_everywhere_at_once::temporary_is_vetoed(ctx, source, unit)) and skip the source when it reads true; a Sprite at her battlefield survives its controller's Beginning Phase while one in the base dies.

clusters.title: SelfCost::BanishSelf and the banished-with link
clusters.primitive: CardState gains banished_by: Option<u32> set by Ctx::banish when run for an item whose source is a card (the Sarcophagus's play trigger, Jhin's banish, The Zero Drive's wearer deathknell) and read by units_banished_with / spells_banished_with; cleared when the card leaves Banishment. cards/mod.rs: SelfCost::BanishSelf paid by activate::pay_self / trigger finalization (ravenbloom_prefect; add Trigger::OpponentPlaysGear beside OpponentPlaysUnit). cost::origin_cost: an Origin::Banishment play charges the printed cost unless the item says free (Sarcophagus pays two energy, Zero Drive's reclaim ignores costs). the_zero_drive also needs UnitDies(Friendly) granted through wearer-abilities; jhin_virtuoso needs the paid cost from played-spell-payload.

clusters.title: Legends can be Empowered
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::set_counter / empower / disempower / is_empowered: read face_in_play (board or the legend zone) instead of on_board so COUNTER_EMPOWERED lands on a legend and Event::Empowered is raised; cards/mod.rs Filter::Legend joins the EMPOWER_TARGET candidates (profiteer::legend_can_be_empowered). Akali / Jayce / Kennen Empower resolutions then leave the legend Empowered.

clusters.title: SelfCost::Disempower
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: SelfCost::Disempower beside KillSelf and BanishTarget. engine/activate.rs pay_self: pay it through Ctx::disempower at finalization, before the ability is on the chain, and refuse the activation (offers greyed) while the source is not Empowered; the scripts drop their usable_if gate and the run's disempower. Legends (Ambessa, Mel, Kennen, Zed) need the face_in_play read from legend-empower.

clusters.title: Event::Empowered carries the actor; Trigger::Banished(Who::You)
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Event::Empowered gains `by: u8` (the controller of the empowering item, or the card's controller for a rule empower); cards/mod.rs Trigger::YouEmpower (matches by == source controller and card != source; your Profiteer on an enemy unit counts, an opponent's Sanction on your unit does not) so Ambessa - Matriarch of War / Mel - Soul's Reflection empower themselves; Trigger::Banished(Who::You) matched on Event::Banished { owner } == source controller (Zed empowers on banishing a card you own). Both legends need legend-empower.

clusters.title: Non-resource activation costs picked at the pay stage
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: SelfCost gains target-bearing arms KillTarget(&'static Filter), RecycleTargets(u8, &'static Filter) (from the trash), ExhaustTarget(&'static Filter) and SelfCost::And(&'static [SelfCost]) so an ability can combine Exhaust with a pick. engine/activate.rs: before the item is created, prompt the pick (PromptWhy::Cost { .. } with the filter's candidates), refuse the activation when no candidate exists, and pay it (kill / recycle / exhaust) together with the rune cost in pay_self, so nothing can be undone by a response (818.1.c.3, 204.1.b). malzahar_fanatic's [Add] activation is also uncounterable: an ability whose run only adds resources resolves at once without a chain item (429.3).

clusters.title: Costs and targets picked as a trigger is finalized
clusters.primitive: engine/triggers.rs finalize (383.3): a triggered ability's SelfCost (RecycleSelf for Ekko, RecycleTarget for Rumble, DisempowerTarget over profiteer::empowered_things_you_control) is picked and paid when the trigger is finalized, before opponents react, using the pay-stage pick machinery of activation-pay-stage-picks; a target listed in Ability.targets is chosen at finalization too, with its Deflect paid then (akali_deadly_weapon, 355.5.b / 383.3.a), raising Chosen at that point instead of a Resume at resolution.

clusters.title: Empower costs that discard or kill
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Keyword::Empower(Cost) gains a companion EmpowerCost { runes: Cost, extra: Option<SelfCost> } (or Card.empower_extra: SelfCost) so an Empower's discard (Punching Poro; Mel - Defiant Soul restricted to spells in hand, refused otherwise) or kill (Escaped Grayback) is a pick at the pay stage (355.10.c, 357) that raises no Chosen and cannot be undone. Reuses the pick prompt from activation-pay-stage-picks; the Empower activation path in activate.rs pays it with the runes.

clusters.title: Repeat costs that discard and escalating Repeat steps
clusters.primitive: engine/play.rs begin/advance STAGE_REPEAT: a Keyword::Repeat may carry a non-resource cost (RepeatCost::Discard(n)) picked before the item exists and withheld when the hand is empty (Square Up); Curtain Call's escalating steps (820.1.c.2, 820.3) are offered as separate Repeat asks — energy, then rainbow, then energy-plus-rainbow — each adding an execution, with the modes for each execution chosen at play time (820.2) and stored on the item (executions_paid). Shares the additional-stage prompt shape of additional-cost-kinds.

clusters.title: Either-or costs and reductions chosen by the player
clusters.primitive: engine/pay.rs plan / play.rs STAGE_PAY: when an ExtraCost or a Static::SpellDiscount offers alternatives (legion_marauder: recycle a ready Body rune instead of exhausting; irelia_graceful: take the energy or the power off), the pay stage asks the player (PromptWhy::PayChoice with the labelled alternatives) instead of the script picking. Introduce ExtraCost -> CostChoice (one Cost, or a list) and Discount -> DiscountChoice; the picked alternative is recorded on the item.

clusters.title: Non-resource additional costs at STAGE_ADDITIONAL
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: replace Card.additional: Option<Cost> with Option<Additional> where Additional { kind: Runes(Cost) | Discard(u8) | Kill { filter, count: One|AnyNumber } | Exhaust(filter) | ExhaustLegend | ReturnGear, optional: bool, offered: Option<Usable> (crescent_guardian gate), discount: Option<fn(&Ctx, &[u32]) -> Cost> }. engine/play.rs advance STAGE_ADDITIONAL: offer the confirm, prompt the pick(s) with candidates, refuse the play when a mandatory kind has no candidate (Cruel Patron, Sacrifice, Heedless Resurrection, Legion Quartermaster, Stalking Wolf), pay it before the item finalizes (discard to trash, kill, exhaust), record paid_additional and the picked cards on the item (Event::Played.paid_additional already exists) and apply the discount to the price (Brazen Buccaneer two energy off; Atakhan the victim's printed costs; Ledros one Order per kill). stalking_wolf's PlayLocation prompt then offers the victim's battlefield (play_locations_with_the_kill consulted at the location stage).

clusters.title: XP spends and spend-a-buff as costs
clusters.primitive: cards::Cost gains `xp: u8` (or Additional::Xp(n)) so Card.additional can ask 3 XP (Safety Inspector, Poppy) or 5 XP (Conscription), offered at STAGE_ADDITIONAL only when the seat holds it and spent from SeatState.xp when paid. Additional::SpendBuff { count: One|AnyNumber, replaces_cost: bool, discount } spends a friendly unit's buff at the pay stage (Ctx::spend_buff): Wallop / Call to Glory playable for the buff alone with no ready rune, Kraken Hunter one Body power off per buff. SelfCost::SpendBuff pays the buff at activation for Sett - Brawler (204.1.b).

clusters.title: Additional costs and locations offered by another card
clusters.primitive: engine/play.rs advance STAGE_ADDITIONAL: beside the played card's own Additional, consult in-play cards for a Static::OffersAdditional(fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem) -> Option<Additional>) (dragon_roost::roost_additional_cost: two rainbows for any Dragon of any player); when paid, the location stage consults dragon_roost::roost_play_location in place of the location prompt so the Dragon lands at the roost.

clusters.title: Discard as a base activation cost
clusters.primitive: engine/activate.rs: an ability whose Cost carries Discard(n, filter) (a kind-filtered hand pick, gear for Sky Cruiser, any card for Unlicensed Armory / Gutter Palace) prompts PromptWhy::Discard before the item exists and pays it with the energy and the exhaust (204.1.b). Uses the pick machinery of activation-pay-stage-picks. Cross-lane notes: unlicensed_armory:370 also asserts the Fury 'may' on the kill path (damage lane kill-path-prompt) and gutter_palace:410 asserts the Bird has its own script (economy lane token-faces); un-ignore those two after the merge.

clusters.title: ExtraCost evaluated on the item after targets
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: ExtraCost becomes fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem, Source) -> Cost (or a second ItemExtraCost slot) evaluated at choose_targets and STAGE_PAY, with legal::classify's any_affordable path deciding legality against the cheapest possible target; hextech_gauntlets::discounted(ctx, wearer) prices the Equip off the chosen unit's Might so one ready rune equips a 3-Might unit for the rainbow alone.

clusters.title: Static::EntersReady and the per-seat enter-ready flags
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::EntersReady(Applies). engine/play.rs finalize (369.3) and Ctx::spawn: after placing the unit, consult its own EntersReady statics and in-play auras/grants (Magma Wurm for other friendly units here, Renata - Industrialist for tokens) plus two SeatState flags reset at Expiration — units_enter_ready_this_turn (Confront, Bushwhack) and next_unit_enters_ready (Sun Disc, spent on the first unit) — and leave the unit ready instead of exhausting every non-Accelerate unit; token makers pass a ready hint instead of a constant. Every card's enters_ready seam is the Applies.

clusters.title: Per-turn death record
clusters.primitive: blob/SeatState gains deaths_this_turn: Vec<Death { card, controller, unit: bool, phase: Phase }> appended by kill.rs and cleared at Expiration, exposed as Ctx::deaths_this_turn(); shadow_watcher (friendly death in the Beginning Phase) and towering_pairofant (any unit death) read it from their EntersReady Applies, spoils_of_war's discount counts enemy unit deaths across requests.

clusters.title: IMPLICIT_VISION and IMPLICIT_WEAPONMASTER
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: IMPLICIT_VISION and IMPLICIT_WEAPONMASTER beside IMPLICIT_TEMPORARY. engine/triggers.rs find_among: on Event::Entered for a unit carrying Keyword::Vision at entry (printed or granted through an aura — Gemcraft Seer, Forecaster) queue a play trigger that peeks the top card of the controller's main deck to the controller and asks [recycle it, keep] (817, once per instance); for Keyword::Weaponmaster (printed or from Azir's aura) queue the attach-a-loose-equipment offer that only a script's weaponmaster() runs today. Vision raises the recycle through Ctx::recycle.

clusters.title: Grant::Static(Level / Aura / NoMoveByEnemy) read off attachments
clusters.primitive: engine/statics.rs own_grants / aura_grants / grants_on: walk Grant::Static(..) entries from attach::granted_statics on the wearer's gear, so a Level(3, ..) line on Soul Sword gives the wearer +1 at 3 XP, an Aura in Shurelya's Requiem's effect text projects Ganking onto friendly units at the wearer's battlefield, and a new Static::NoMoveByEnemy granted by Jagged Cutlass is read through item_cannot_move(ctx, item, unit) in march::effect_move, targets::candidates (Filter::Movable) and the group-move prompt whenever an enemy spell or ability would move the wearer.

clusters.title: NoMoveToBase read off units
clusters.primitive: engine/march.rs route/effect_move and Ctx::movable_to_base / moves_to_base_from: beside the battlefield card's Static::NoMoveToBase, consult a per-unit cannot_move_to_base(ctx, unit) (Determined Sentry: itself only) and a table-wide units_cannot_move_to_base(ctx) (Minotaur Reckoner: every unit of both sides, effect moves included), refusing the march and the effect move.

clusters.title: Ready suppression statics
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::ReadySuppressed { by_effects: Applies, by_awaken: Applies }. engine/ctx.rs Ctx::ready (spells and abilities) and Ctx::awaken consult in-play cards: Mageseeker Warden at a battlefield forbids spells and abilities readying enemy units and gear while Awaken still readies them; Maduli the Gatekeeper is never readied by Awaken or any effect.

clusters.title: Granted Flow, Repeat and Accelerate
clusters.primitive: CardState gains a granted_costed: Vec<(Keyword, Expiry)> row (Keyword::from_codes drops costed keywords, so store Flow(Cost)/Repeat(Cost) with their cost) written by Ctx::grant_keyword_this_turn; legal::flow_cost and activate::flow_playable read it (Kennen lends Flow for the turn); play::advance STAGE_REPEAT and chain::run's repeat pass consult a Static::GrantsRepeat(fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem) -> Option<Cost>) on in-play cards (Syndra in a showdown); cost::can_accelerate consults in-play grants with the pending item's origin (rek_sai_breacher::grants_accelerate for a champion-zone play).

clusters.title: Quick-Draw timing and hand-zone grants
clusters.primitive: engine/hide.rs reacts and engine/legal.rs timing: read Keyword::QuickDraw as Reaction timing for an Equipment play (Long Sword drops its explicit Reaction). engine/statics.rs grants_on: consult a hand-zone grant (Jax - Unmatched: friendly Equipment in hand have Quick-Draw) so a hand card's keywords include it; play::finalize attaches the gear to a chosen unit as it resolves when played with Quick-Draw.

clusters.title: Filter::Equipped
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Filter::Equipped (and Unequipped) read by targets::matches through attach::attachments_of; strike_down's first target offers only friendly units wearing gear.

clusters.title: A unit's own NoCombatDamageFrom
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::deals_combat_damage: also consult the unit's own Static::NoCombatDamageFrom(Suppresses) with itself as the subject (Ezreal - Dashing, Galio - Indefatigable always; Sacred Protector unless exactly one other friendly unit shares its battlefield), so combat.rs assigns it no damage.

clusters.title: An aura registered for the turn by a resolved spell
clusters.primitive: blob gains floating_auras: Vec<{ source, seat, grants: &'static [Grant], scope, when, until: Expiry }> registered by Ctx::aura_this_turn from a resolving script and cleared at Expiration; engine/statics.rs aura_grants folds them like an in-play Static::Aura so Stand United's extra Might reaches a unit buffed later this turn.

clusters.title: Play to an open battlefield
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::PlayLocations(fn(&Ctx, seat, card) -> Vec<Location>) (or Static::PlayToOpenBattlefields(Applies)). engine/ctx.rs play_locations and engine/legal.rs play_to / locations_for: union the card's own grant (Sneaky Deckhand, Ocean Drake, Sai Scout) and grants from other in-play cards (Miss Fortune - Buccaneer for friendly units) with the base and held battlefields; a unit landing on an open battlefield contests it (cleanup::establish).

clusters.title: Sorcery-speed plays onto enemy-held battlefields
clusters.primitive: Extend the PlayLocations consult: Deadbloom Predator / Dauntless Vanguard / Arachnoid Horror (and the friendly units he grants it to) may be played at Action timing to a battlefield where an enemy unit stands alone, and combat opens as they land (showdown::open from play::finalize, as an Ambush entry does); Rengar - Pouncing may be played to the battlefield of the combat his controller is attacking and joins as an attacker (combat.rs adds him to the attackers). Static::AmbushIntoEnemies stays Ambush-timed.

clusters.title: Play-location restrictions and locks
clusters.primitive: Static::OnlyPlayLocations(fn) replaces the list (Perched Grimwyrm: refused at the base, only battlefields conquered this turn) and Static::OpponentsPlayUnitsOnlyToBase (Mageseeker Warden at a battlefield) filters opponents' unit locations; both consulted by Ctx::play_locations and legal::play_to so the PlayLocation prompt and the legal list agree.

clusters.title: The engine serves a limited play inside a resolution
clusters.primitive: engine/play.rs begin: accept a LimitedPlay { origin: Origin, locations: Vec<Location>, price: Printed|Free|PowerOnly, by: seat } handed by a resolving script (Ctx::play_limited), so legal::locations_for does not apply the play timing or the closed chain to it and the engine's own PlayLocation prompt serves the given list (The Harrowing, Thrill of the Hunt any battlefield, Rek'Sai - Swarm Queen with her battlefield added). Event::Played reports the real origin (Origin::Hand for Here to Help, Rift Herald, Rell - Magnetic, Bone Skewer's other-seat play) and a cancelled play returns the card to that zone. The candidate list for a hand play is face-aware (decide sees the seat's own hand faces) and offers only units whose cost the seat can pay.

clusters.title: Origin::Revealed for deck-revealed plays
clusters.primitive: state.rs Origin gains Revealed { from: Deck } (with a CBOR code) and a PowerOnly price; play::begin uses it for cards revealed off the deck (Dazzling Aurora, Rek'Sai - Swarm Queen, Void Rush, Promising Future) so Event::Played reports the reveal and play::cancel puts an unplayable card back on top of the deck (or to the trash where the card says) instead of Banishment.

clusters.title: Replaying the resolving spell from the trash
clusters.primitive: engine/chain.rs run: after a spell's run returns Done and chain::leave files it in the trash, honour a pending Replay { card, by: seat, cost: Cost } the script registered (Ctx::offer_replay_from_trash) by offering the paid replay through the limited play of limited-play-mid-resolution with Origin::Trash { leave: Leave::Banish }; Dancing Grenade also keeps a per-spell deals-this-turn count on the blob so the replay deals two plus one.

clusters.title: Units playable from the trash
clusters.primitive: engine/legal.rs from_trash / locations_for and activate::flow_playable: beside Flow spells, offer a unit whose script grants a trash play (Undying Legion under Legion, for its printed cost plus a Fury, entering the base) and every card of a seat under a Static::MayPlayFromTrash (Endless Riches) priced as a hand play with Origin::Trash { leave: Leave::Banish }; the offer label says 'play from your trash' and Event::Played reports the trash origin.

clusters.title: Hidden capacity, alternative hide costs, free hides and reveal blocks
clusters.primitive: engine/hide.rs: legal reads a per-battlefield capacity from a Static::HideCapacity(u8) (Bandle Tree takes two); cost() consults the card's alternative_hide_cost (Teemo: a [Hidden] card hides for 1 energy and the rune exhausts instead of recycling) and a per-seat free_hide_this_turn flag set by Guerilla Warfare and cleared at Expiration; play_legal checks opponents' units at the battlefield with a Static::BlocksReveal (Noxus Saboteur) before allowing the facedown play.

clusters.title: Stolen cards leave to their owner's zones
clusters.primitive: engine/chain.rs leave and engine/play.rs cancel: file a resolved or cancelled card in its OWNER's trash / Banishment instead of the item controller's (157, 359.3.d, 056.2) so a stolen spell (Mystic Reversal, Blind Fury) lands where it belongs.

clusters.title: Reveal hooks and peeked faces
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs reveal_top: before revealing, consult in-play statics for a look-first replacement (Void Hatchling: peek, ask [recycle, keep], then reveal what is left) and after revealing consult the revealed card's own on-reveal add (Undertitan adds two energy to the rune pool through the existing banked add). The plugin's fold exposes the faces of cards a seat peeked (Reinforce's five) so a candidate list can tell units from spells before they reach Banishment.

clusters.title: [Add] abilities as payment sources at the pay stage
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::Adds(fn(&Ctx, source, &ChainItem) -> Option<Adds { energy, power: Domain|Rainbow, how: Exhaust|Recycle(n), when: Any|Reaction }>) generalising the Gold token. engine/pay.rs plan / choose_payment: for every ready card of the payer with an Adds that applies to the item (Seals: a power of their domain; Energy Conduit / Dragonsoul Sage / Darius under Legion / Diana in a showdown: one energy; Kai'Sa: a rainbow for spells only; Ornn: a rainbow for gear only; Renekton: two energy of a unit by recycling two runes; Platewyrm Egg one energy, two while Empowered; Honeyfruit; Ancient Henge / Hextech Anomaly converting X runes; Renata's Gold also an energy near victory) offer it as a payment source, pay by exhausting (or recycling) the card without a chain item (429.3, uncounterable), and add nothing before a card is played.

clusters.title: A per-seat banked rune pool
clusters.primitive: SeatState gains pool: { energy: u8, power: Vec<Domain|Rainbow> } (167) written by Ctx::add_to_pool from [Add] effects (jhin_murderous_artist::add_to_rune_pool), spent first by pay::plan across any number of plays and abilities of any kind, and emptied by expiry at the end of the turn and at the start of the next Main Phase; the next-card-only next_discount stays for the discounts that are truly next-card.

clusters.title: legal::classify prices with discounts
clusters.primitive: engine/legal.rs classify / from_trash and engine/play.rs begin: price a play with cost::of_item over a provisional ChainItem (folding SpellDiscount, PlayDiscount, floating discounts and the Flow cost) instead of cost::total / flow_cost, so a spell affordable only through Eager Apprentice / Applied Researchers / Vex - Cheerless / Undying Loyalty / Stargazer is offered; price the Repeat ask after SLOT_REPEAT is set (Marai Spire) and the additional-cost confirm after its slot is set, with cost::discounts_of applying SpellDiscount-style discounts to a unit's optional additional cost too (Ezreal - Prodigy).

clusters.title: Static::PlayDiscount and Static::Surcharge from other cards
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs: Static::PlayDiscount(ItemDiscount) for units and gear from another card with a floor (Herald of Scales: Dragons two energy less, min one; Ornn's Forge: gear while held, plus a per-seat gear_played counter reset at Expiration) and Static::Surcharge(ItemDiscount) whose Cost is ADDED in cost::base_of_item (Helm of Suppression, Mystic Vortex on Reaction cards during a showdown here, Vex - Cheerless in combat, Vaults of Helia on the holder's non-token units this turn); cost::discounts_of folds both and legal::classify prices them (depends on discounts-at-classify).

clusters.title: Static::AbilityDiscount
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Static::AbilityDiscount(ItemDiscount) consulted by cost::of_item for ItemKind::Ability (Risen Altar: the Empower of a unit standing here one energy or one rainbow lower; Piltovan Forge: the holder's first gear ability of the turn one energy lower, with a per-seat gear_abilities_activated counter reset at Expiration). risen_altar's energy-or-rainbow pick is the costs lane's pay-stage-alternatives (cross-lane; the test can pass with the script choosing until the merge).

clusters.title: Kind-aware, turn-scoped per-seat promises
clusters.primitive: Replace SeatState.next_discount with promises: Vec<Promise { kind: Spell|Gear|Unit|Any, effect: Discount(Cost)|RepeatForCost|FreeForPower { max_energy }, until: Expiry }> cleared at Expiration; cost::discounts_of applies the first matching promise to the next card of that kind only (Raging Firebrand: spells only, expires with the turn), play::advance STAGE_REPEAT offers a Repeat equal to the spell's printed cost from a RepeatForCost promise (Temporal Portal, The Academy), and a FreeForPower promise lets one gear costing 7 or less play for its Power alone (Jayce - Man of Progress).

clusters.title: Per-seat per-turn counters on SeatState
clusters.primitive: SeatState gains counters reset at Expiration and fed by the engine writers: kinds_played (unit/gear/spell/token, fed by play::finalize even when the card later leaves — Azir's equipment gate, Swain - Visionary), enemy_choices (fed by Ctx::choose / the Chosen event — Hungry Wolf, Ezreal - Prodigal Explorer), holds_this_turn (cleanup::score_holds — Needlessly Large Yordle), xp_gained (Ctx::score_xp — Wily Newtfish), power_spent and energy_spent (pay::pay for runes and Golds — Sivir - Mercenary, Prepared Neophyte), discards (discard.rs — Raging Soul grants Assault 1 and Ganking for the turn). Expose Ctx readers the seams use instead of ctx.events.

clusters.title: Per-card per-turn counters on CardState
clusters.primitive: CardState gains moves_this_turn (fed by march.rs and Ctx::move_unit — Yasuo scores on the third), modes_used bitmask (Udyr refuses a mode chosen this turn even after another buff) and conquered_this_turn (set by cleanup::conquer per unit that conquered, distinct from Control.scored so a battlefield held since the Beginning Phase does not read as conquered — Blighted Battleaxe, Perched Grimwyrm), all reset at Expiration and readable across requests.

clusters.title: A seat's own turn count and first Beginning Phase
clusters.primitive: SeatState gains turns_taken (incremented as the seat's Beginning Phase opens) and a first_beginning_phase_done flag, so an extra turn inside the opening round does not shift is_first_beginning_phase off the table turn number (Obelisk of Power) and turn_number_of reads the seat's fourth turn (Ol' Poro); add Static::PlayVeto(Applies) consulted by legal::classify with its own Reason so Ol' Poro is refused on a seat's first three turns.

clusters.title: Static::AlternativeCost
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Static::AlternativeCost(fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem, u32) -> Option<Cost>) folded by cost::of_item as a replacement price (not a subtraction) and priced by legal::classify, so Jhin - Meticulous Killer plays for one Mind power alone after four energy went into a spell this turn (reads energy_spent from seat-per-turn-counters).

clusters.title: Tags on CardInfo, Filter::Tag, Grant::Tag
clusters.primitive: CardInfo (the projection's face) gains tags: Vec<String> read from the set file (games/riftbound/src/lib.rs manifest rows carry the printed tags: Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro, Dragon, Mech, Recruit, ...); Ctx::has_tag(card, tag) also consults Grant::Tag(&'static str) from attachments (Experimental Hexplate makes the wearer a Mech) and a CardState.chosen_tag set by Ivern - Friend to All's play trigger; cards/mod.rs Filter::Tag(&'static str) for target specs. The name-list seams (daisy::{BIRDS,CATS,DOGS}, poro_herder::is_poro, herald_of_scales::DRAGONS, rumble::is_mech, starhound::is_companion) read the tag instead.

clusters.title: Token::Recruit, Token::Bird, Token::Mech
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Token gains Recruit (1 Might, no domain, the Recruit tag), Bird (1 Might, the Bird tag, printed Deflect 1 with its own script so ctx.script(bird) is Some) and Mech (the Mech tag) with faces; the manifest tokens in games/riftbound/src/lib.rs; TOKEN_RECRUIT / TOKEN_BIRD / TOKEN_MECH and is_token_name in cards/mod.rs. spawn_recruit / spawn_bird / spawn_mech become spawn(ctx, owner, Token::X, at, ready) and the hand-built faces go.

clusters.title: Token::Reflection and Ctx::become_copy
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Token::Reflection (0 Might blank) and Ctx::become_copy(card, of, until: Expiry|WhileAttached(gear)) (477.1.b): CardState gains copy_of: Option<u32> so the projection reads the copied unit's name, script binding, printed Might and keywords, with [Temporary] granted after for Keeper of Masks / Mirror Image, LeBlanc - Deceiver's hold, and Shady Spectacles' wearer reverting on detach; cards/mod.rs knows the Reflection name.

clusters.title: A replacement on token plays
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::spawn: before placing a token, consult in-play cards for a Static::DoublesTokenPlay(Applies) (zilean_time_mage::would_double_a_token_play, once each turn via spend_the_doubling) and, on a yes to the optional (371.2), spawn one more of the same face at the same location with the same ready state (375).

clusters.title: Group-move surcharges
clusters.primitive: state.rs PromptWhy::GroupMove gains a cost; engine/march.rs group_move prices each companion through group_move_surcharge(ctx, seat, to, picked + 1) summed from in-play cards (Mageseeker Investigator: one energy per unit beyond the first moving to him), prompts::options greys a companion the seat cannot afford beside the picks so far, and march::group_move pays the surcharge before the units move.

clusters.title: Bonus damage keyed on the cause
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::damage: before prevention, sum bonus_damage(ctx, unit, cause) from a new Static::BonusDamage(fn(&Ctx, source, unit, &Cause) -> u8) over in-play cards (Void Gate: +1 to a unit here from a spell; Rabadon's Deathcrown: +3 from a spell of the wearer's controller) and from a per-seat next-spell-damage promise on SeatState written by Ravenborn Tome and spent by the first spell damage of that seat this turn (712-715, 715.4.a, 417.4).

clusters.title: Static::NoDamage and static prevention
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Static::NoDamage(fn(&Ctx, unit, &Cause) -> bool). engine/ctx.rs Ctx::damage returns false and marks nothing when it applies (Ambessa - The Wolf while Empowered out of combat; Kayn - Unleashed after two moves; Esteemed Hierophant with seven runes against an enemy item, 437.1.b.1.b), and combat.rs / cleanup::dying exempt the unit from lethal assignment (465.2.c.10). kayn_unleashed:104 also reads moves_this_turn from the economy lane's card-per-turn-counters (cross-lane; un-ignore after the merge).

clusters.title: Prevention on a unit with Amount::Next / Amount::N
clusters.primitive: state.rs Prevention gains unit: Option<u32> and Amount::Next; engine/prevent.rs reduce(card, n, cause) matches the unit it is asked about, spends a Next shield on the first Ctx::damage to that unit (Counter Strike) and decrements an N shield across instances (Ki Barrier's seven), clearing at Expiration; registered by prevent_the_next_damage_to.

clusters.title: A per-unit damage multiplier for the turn
clusters.primitive: CardState gains damage_multiplier_this_turn: u8 (reset at Expiration) written by Lotus Trap's resolution; Ctx::damage multiplies after prevention (465.2.c.4, 712-715) so every damage to the trapped unit this turn is doubled.

clusters.title: Damage marked per player and lethal consults
clusters.primitive: CardState damage becomes per-marker (a map controller -> u8 beside the total) written by Ctx::damage from the cause's controller; cleanup::dying consults a Static::LethalDamage(fn(&Ctx, source, unit) -> bool) (elder_dragon::any_of_your_damage_is_lethal_to) before comparing the total to current_might, so one damage from the Dragon's controller kills an enemy unit at cleanup (142.3).

clusters.title: A 'may' on the kill path and legend replacements
clusters.primitive: engine/kill.rs applicable / run: a Replacement gains optional: bool and a cost; when it applies, the kill path asks the controller PromptWhy::OptionalCost (pay a rune and exhaust Sett - The Boss; pay the Altar of Blood's price) and a 'no' lets the unit die; applicable also walks faces in the legend zone (Sett - The Boss) beside the board.

clusters.title: Kill replacements registered for the turn
clusters.primitive: blob gains floating_replacements: Vec<{ unit: Option<u32>, seat, replacement, spend: Once|Every, until: Expiry }> registered by a resolving spell (Tactical Retreat: the next friendly death this turn becomes a retreat; Smite: the smitten unit is banished instead of dying, by its own damage or a later kill) and consulted by kill::applicable beside in-play faces, spent on first use and cleared at Expiration.

clusters.title: Might layers: re-entrant reads, aura floors, base overrides, amplified deltas
clusters.primitive: engine/statics.rs current_might / own_grants: a re-entrant Might reading that excludes the querying static (476) so a While(applies) may read might_before_my_keywords including aura Might (Fiora - Victorious); a per-aura minimum on projected Might (Leona - Zealot: a stunned enemy here reads at least 1); CardState.base_might_override: Option<u8> for the turn read first by current_might so a second Dragon Form sets the base again instead of stacking (dragon_form::base_might_becomes); Ctx::might on a negative delta run for a chain item passes the amount through Static::AmplifiesMinus(fn) (Mel - Newly Awakened while Empowered: -1 reads -2).

clusters.title: Replacements on the stun, -Might and bounce paths
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::stun, Ctx::might (negative) and Ctx::bounce, when run for a chain item of another controller, consult a Static::ShrugsOff(fn(&Ctx, unit, &ChainItem) -> bool) and run the card's replacement instead (gangplank_naval::plus_three_instead), so the opponent's Stupefy leaves him unstunned, unshrunk and at +3 Might.

clusters.title: Modal prompts with named modes
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Ability / Card gain modes: &'static [Mode { label, targets: &'static [TargetSpec], run }]; state.rs PromptWhy::Mode { options: Vec<String> } asked at play time before any target pick (Disposal Order, Rocket Barrage, Sanction, Mesmerize, Party Favors, Minah - Swiftfoot) or from a Resume (Jayce - Hammer in Hand's choose_one over MODES), stored on the ChainItem as mode: u8 and read by the run through mode_of; the presenter phrases the labels rather than TargetRefs.

clusters.title: Anchor-relative target filters
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Filter gains SameControllerAs(u8), MightLessThan(u8) and ItemTargetsOnly(u8) (an item that chooses the anchor pick and no other friendly unit); engine/targets.rs matches / candidates_with evaluate them against the pick at that index so Angle Shot, Public Execution and Repulse offer only legal second targets.

clusters.title: Anchors resolved within a Repeat group
clusters.primitive: engine/targets.rs matches: anchor indices (NotSame(n), DifferentLocationFrom(n), SameLocationAs(n) and the new relations) are resolved relative to the current Repeat group's own picks, not the item's absolute target list, so Piercing Light's and Temptation's second group measure against their own first pick.

clusters.title: 355.11 group targeting over the picks so far
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Filter gains TotalMightAtMost(u8) and DifferentLocationFromPicks; engine/targets.rs candidates_with reads the picks so far and refuses a pick that would break the total (Fox-Fire 4, Decree of Discord 5, Tricksy Tentacles 8) or repeat a location (Elder Dragon) at the prompt instead of trimming at resolution.

clusters.title: Zone filters over the units standing there
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Filter gains ZoneWithUnits(Rel) (a battlefield where you / the same controller have units — Moonfall, Shadow Dash, Temptation's destination) and InShowdown (units at the battlefield of the open showdown — Akali - Rogue Assassin, with no legal target when none is open); engine/targets.rs in_universe / matches read the zone's units and the open showdown.

clusters.title: A name prompt kind and a stored name
clusters.primitive: state.rs PromptWhy::Name { kind: SpellName|Tag, options } and CardState.named: Option<String> written by the play trigger (Fallen Feline names a spell, The List names a tag); engine/legal.rs classify consults fallen_feline::cannot_play (a lock keyed on the name while she stands at a battlefield) and The List's target spec uses Filter::Tag over the stored name (cross-lane: Filter::Tag lands with the economy lane's tags-on-the-face; The List's test is un-ignored after the merge).

clusters.title: Facedown cards in a Card target universe
clusters.primitive: engine/targets.rs in_universe: admit friendly facedown cards to a Card spec when the filter says Filter::Facedown (or Friendly + HiddenBattlefield) so Pack of Wonders can offer a Hidden card beside gear and units and return it to hand.

clusters.title: Level-gated TargetSpecs
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs TargetSpec gains min_at_level: Option<(u8 xp, u8 min)> or a gate: Option<Usable>; engine/targets.rs choose_targets skips the spec entirely below the XP and requires min picks at or above it (Skyward Strike's stun target at Level 6).

clusters.title: Score vetoes, score replacements, VictoryScore and a direct win
clusters.primitive: engine/cleanup.rs establish / score_holds and Ctx::score consult in-play statics before a point is scored: Static::NoScoreHere(fn(&Ctx, zone, seat) -> bool) on a battlefield (Forgotten Monument: control changes hands, nothing is marked scored, no Conquered/Held event), Static::OpponentsCannotScore(Applies) (Tianna Crownguard), Static::DrawInsteadOfScoring(fn) (Otterpus on a player's first two turns); Ctx::points_winner / Ctx::score sum Static::VictoryScore(i32) from in-play cards into options.victory_score (Aspirant's Climb); Ctx::win(seat) ends the game directly without touching the point counters (The Grand Plaza).

clusters.title: Uncounterable items
clusters.primitive: cards/mod.rs Static::Uncounterable(Applies) on the item's card (Decree of Rage) and a table-wide Static::ProtectsFromCounter(fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem) -> bool) on in-play cards (Mel - Newly Awakened while Empowered, her controller's spells and abilities); engine/chain.rs counter / Ctx::counter_item leave such an item on the chain and the counter spells' candidate lists exclude it.

clusters.title: Control changes in place
clusters.primitive: engine/control.rs / Ctx::set_controller gains an in_place mode that leaves the stolen unit where it stands, marks the battlefield contested by its new controller and lets cleanup open the combat or conquer (Hostile Takeover); the Possession relocation stays the default.

clusters.title: Battlefield tokens on the board
clusters.primitive: engine/ctx.rs Ctx::add_battlefield_token(face) appends a shared Battlefield zone to the table mid-game (Baron Nashor's Baron Pit with 'Units can move here from anywhere', where his entry is replaced per 369.3) and Ctx::replace_battlefield(zone, face) / swap_back(zone) swap a battlefield's card for a token and back (Ivern - Green Father's Brush); Zones::of, the projection and march::route learn the new zones.

clusters.title: Counter caps read from the card
clusters.primitive: games/riftbound/src/lib.rs manifest and the fixture counter table: COUNTER_EMPOWERED and COUNTER_BUFFED become counts, with Ctx::empower / Ctx::buff incrementing up to a per-card cap read from a Static::CounterCap { counter, max } (Kayle - Justified: three Empowers; Lee Sin - Ascetic: any number of buffs, each +2 Might) and defaulting to one elsewhere; is_empowered / is_buffed read nonzero.

clusters.title: Beginning-phase and zone game-rule statics
clusters.primitive: engine/phases.rs continue_beginning consults Static::SkipsDrawPhase(Applies) (Endless Riches) before the Draw Phase draw and Static::ChannelCount(fn(&Ctx, seat) -> u8) (Sandstone Chimera at a battlefield: one rune) in place of rules::runes_this_turn; Ctx::trash, discard.rs and the kill path consult Static::BanishesInsteadOfTrash(fn(&Ctx, card, from) -> bool) on every trash-bound move except the Burn from the main deck (Endless Riches).

clusters.title: Combat and Deflect game-rule statics
clusters.primitive: engine/combat.rs candidates / ordered consult a per-assigner Static::IgnoresTank(fn(&Ctx, source, assigner, zone) -> bool) (Dune Surfer's controller assigns past opposing Tanks); cleanup::after_combat step 3d consults Static::TieRecallsAll(fn) and runs recall_all(zone) on a tied combat where the Symbol of the Solari's controller attacks; cost::deflect consults a table-wide Static::DeflectIgnoredHere(fn(&Ctx, &ChainItem, extra) -> bool) (Heisho Shell of the World) before summing the chosen cards' Deflect for any player's item.

clusters.title: The Chosen Champion on SeatState
clusters.primitive: SeatState gains chosen_champion: Option<String> filled from the deck at table setup (103.2.a.3); hallowed_tomb::is_chosen_champion reads it so only the chosen champion returns from the trash when two of the legend's tag lie there.

clusters.title: A can't-play-cards lock
clusters.primitive: SeatState.no_spells widens to a play lock kinds mask (Spells | Units | Gear) written by Brynhir Thundersong's lock_cards and read by legal::classify for every kind, so the opponent's Reaction units and gear are refused too while the lock stands.
